documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Policy (University Policies)
documents.stance_why: The document restricts AI use for university business and data: members 'must not enter Rowan internal, confidential, proprietary or regulated data' into public tools, and business 'must only be processed in officially approved AI/LLM platforms'. It sets no rule for student coursework and defers to the Academic Integrity Policy, so the stance is restrict for the area it governs.
documents.summary: A university-wide Information Security policy on AI and LLMs adopted in 2024 and revised in 2026. It forbids putting non-public Rowan data into public AI tools and confines university business, including academic communication, to approved platforms. It addresses coursework only by deferring to the Academic Integrity Policy.
